name.zh: 最终战后的五王后决定
name.en: Five-Queen Decision After the Final Battle

periods.summary: After Fugil is defeated and the world-threatening battle ends, Kururushifa forces Lux and the heroines to confront the relationships created by the Ouroboros loop. Rather than letting Lux choose only one girl, she proposes that he become king and marry all five: Lisha, Celistia, Kururushifa, Philphy and Yatoro.
periods.cause: The Ouroboros Eternal Return loop left memories of Lux reaching separate romantic futures with multiple heroines.
periods.process: Kururushifa argues that choosing one would invalidate real bonds. Lisha reluctantly accepts; the others agree. Airi and the Three Harmonies observe the decision.
periods.outcome: Lux's provisional kingship and five weddings become the post-war political and romantic settlement.
periods.aftermath: Lux begins individual visits with each bride and prepares for public succession.
periods.significance: Sets the entire final volume's structure and resolves the post-loop romantic conflict.
